en.name: AR-15 Magpul MOE pistol grip (Black)
en.description: The polymer Magpul MOE (Magpul Original Equipment) pistol grip can be installed on any weapon compatible with AR-15 pistol grips. Thanks to the ergonomic shape and anti-slip texture, it makes the weapon grip and control more comfortably. The inside of the grip contains free space for spare parts, tools, batteries, and an accessories kit.
